children: Faraday Future amended its $10 million senior convertible note with an institutional investor to permit prepayment of principal and interest and to establish a flexible repayment schedule. In a related step, the company, the investor and East West Bank amended the deposit account control agreement that secures the note and the May 15, 2026 securities purchase agreement. Together, the changes are designed to enhance liquidity management and operational flexibility while preserving lender protections.
